功能开发.reason: 实体规则、图查询、可见版本与镜像安装可支撑新的数据库能力。

功能优化.reason: 现有提交、固定读及路径工作流支持改变可观察的行为而保留版本语义。

泛Agent需求.reason: 可把有向图见证、历史视图和镜像内容转成独立的下游数据或决策交付。

代码重构.reason: 可分离候选判定、不可变读根、持久切换和恢复的内部责任，保留现有 API。

依赖升级与迁移.reason: 实际版本一磁盘和可传输镜像、严格标量与旧 HTTP 入口提供兼容迁移输入。

质量保障.reason: 可以用独立图模型和进程操作记录验证路径代价、提交原子性和持久可见性。

项目维护.reason: 录入模式、替换属性、导出与回读形成有条件的消费者和维护文档。

技术讨论.reason: 有读写全量重建、弧身份、固定视图资源与多种读形态可进行架构选择。

问题排查与诊断.reason: 可用公开接口复现选择不同视图或查询规则时的表面冲突，并定位受影响范围。

部署运维.reason: 真实数据目录锁、启动验证、写入稳定性及固定视图边界支持部署和恢复演练。

Bugfix.reason: 健康基线无已查实且保留的契约违例；不预埋缺陷。

tension_points.description: Mode changes validate old records in the proposed state
tension_points.observable_failure: A new required field or incompatible endpoint rule slips into the head

tension_points.description: Sequential private edits must permit a valid final unique swap, but reject a stale base
tension_points.observable_failure: A read observes an intermediate conflict, orphan or lost change

tension_points.description: A vertex ID can be present in head and missing in the chosen pin
tension_points.observable_failure: The older view reads a newer vertex

tension_points.description: Typed equality and missing value have different semantics
tension_points.observable_failure: A posting returns a wrong-type or absent property

tension_points.description: Merging directions preserves parallel arcs but emits each loop once
tension_points.observable_failure: Two distinct arcs collapse or the loop consumes two rows

tension_points.description: Depth is not the same as an arc inspection allowance
tension_points.observable_failure: A partial frontier is presented as the complete reachable set

tension_points.description: The cheapest prefix may spend hops needed by the final route
tension_points.observable_failure: A feasible bounded path is missed

tension_points.description: Directional membership depends on selected kinds; crossing arcs are not component identities
tension_points.observable_failure: Weak components replace mutually reachable groups

tension_points.description: A bounded pinned revision is independent of head but not durable
tension_points.observable_failure: A release changes a resolved read or a restart revives a handle

tension_points.description: Two revisions must resolve together; record identity and schema are compared separately
tension_points.observable_failure: The difference silently compares another graph or misclassifies retained keys

tension_points.description: The digest certifies bytes, not rule compatibility or target namespace ownership
tension_points.observable_failure: An incompatible or foreign image replaces durable state

tension_points.description: Exclusive ownership precedes recovery; a malformed head cannot pass readiness
tension_points.observable_failure: A second writer starts or valid graphs are served despite a corrupt installed head
